title: trait-based key abstraction: DecryptionKey / SigningKey is the right design
description: The key traits (DecryptionKey, SigningKey) with default-impl stub methods (agree_ecdh, preferred_digest_algorithm, supported_key_enc_algorithm) correctly anticipate the HSM/hardware-token use case. A contributor might suggest inlining RSA/EC key types directly (simpler for the common case), but that would lock out HSM callers. The default-stub pattern for agree_ecdh is particularly clean: it compiles without error for RSA-only implementations, and fails loudly with a diagnostic error when ECDH messages arrive. This is the correct tradeoff.
close_reason: P3 opinion/style: no correctness issue, deferred.
